selected_problem: Fresh-main reproduction found atomic replacement writes create a new temporary file with default permissions and rename it over the target. An executable regular file therefore lost its POSIX mode during transactional apply, while a deleted executable restored by rollback also had no stored mode to recover. Mode-only human edits were additionally invisible to optimistic-concurrency preflight.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: Fresh-main reproduction isolated one evidence-rich central reversibility and concurrency bottleneck in the existing transaction path. The committed four-mode router's singular-bottleneck gate routes the replay to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT; no forced rotation was used.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt or fabricated numeric DWAC score is claimed.

pre_fix_reproduction.fixture: Create an executable regular file with mode 0755, then perform the exact existing atomic-write pattern: write a temporary file with default mode and rename it over the target.
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: On the verification host the target mode changed from 0755 to 0644, proving transactional content replacement did not preserve executable metadata.

changes: WorkspaceService.stat now exposes regular-file POSIX mode and WorkspaceService.write preserves an existing regular-file mode across atomic replacement; an explicit mode can be supplied when recreating a deleted file.
Changeset staging snapshots regular-file mode, apply preflight rejects mode-only drift, apply receipts record resulting mode, and rollback preflight rejects post-apply mode-only drift.
Rollback restores the staged mode when recreating a deleted or replaced regular file.
Focused regressions cover executable-mode preservation through write/apply/rollback, deleted-file mode restoration, and fail-closed handling of a mode-only edit before apply.

validation.tests: 3/3 focused POSIX file-mode regressions PASS; 0 skipped on the Linux verification host
validation.pre_fix_observation: Fresh-main atomic replacement reproduced executable-mode loss: 0755 became 0644.

truth_boundaries: This closes regular-file POSIX mode preservation and mode-only concurrency detection in the current transaction path; it does not claim preservation of ownership, ACLs, extended attributes, timestamps, hard-link topology, or platform-specific metadata.
The focused mode assertions are POSIX-specific; Windows permission semantics are not claimed equivalent and the regression explicitly skips there.
Crash-level filesystem atomicity, OS-level validation sandboxing, Windows descendant-tree equivalence, and arbitrary complex semantic synthesis remain unresolved.
No GitHub Actions are intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push is used, and no credential, payment, formal Release, or destructive/irreversible external action is performed.
